predictions.articleTitle: St. Lucia vs Barbados Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Can Barbados Breach Latchoo's Block?
predictions.coreRecommendation: St. Lucia is projected to avoid defeat in a controlled, low-scoring CONCACAF Nations League Group B decider leaning toward Under 2.5 goals and BTTS: No.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw anchored by St. Lucia's higher goal lambda and promotion cushion (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals supported by the 2.25 combined lambda and 60.9% Poisson projection (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
BTTS: No / St. Lucia Clean Sheet backed by Barbados's recent shutout loss at Stade Roger Zami (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: St. Lucia needs one point for Gold Cup; Barbados must attack.

spf.comment: Covers both St. Lucia edging a 1:0 counter-attacking victory and a cautious 1:1 stalemate, since a single point secures Group B promotion and a single call would ignore their incentive to protect a draw.

over_under.comment: A 2.25 combined goal lambda, 60.9% Poisson Under 2.5 density, and Barbados's conservative 5-4-1 setup point toward two or fewer goals.

btts.comment: The 54.6% Poisson BTTS: No baseline aligns with St. Lucia's reinforced backline and Barbados failing to score in a 0:3 loss at this stadium five days prior.

score.comment: 1:0 reflects St. Lucia capitalizing once on late Barbadian risks while keeping a clean sheet, while 1:1 covers the top modal Poisson draw script.

goals.comment: Two goals (26.7%) and one goal (23.7%) represent the two highest-probability bands in the 2.25-lambda goal distribution.

bqc.comment: A cagey opening half favors a level interval before Barbados's must-win second-half push either opens space for a St. Lucia winner or finishes in a stalemate.
